verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot docs claim background/cloud agents that can plan, explore, and execute tasks autonomously, run on schedules, use sandboxes, and be tracked across multiple sessions from a control page—directly supporting parallel long-running agent work. However, this is vendor-only documentation with no independent/community evidence confirming multi-day autonomous fleets in practice, and community feedback focuses on inline completion rather than autonomous agent scale or duration.
